core_obligations: Compute on a good object (proof lines 16755-16772): for a sheaf family G_i and an etale U -> X whose structure morphism factors as U -> V -> S with V -> S etale and U -> V flat of finite presentation with geometrically connected fibres, the displayed chain identifies f^{-1}(prod G_i)(U) = (prod G_i)(V) = prod G_i(V) = prod f^{-1}G_i(U) = (prod f^{-1}G_i)(U), the first and third equalities by sections upstairs together with locality of the pullback.

Spread over a covering (proof lines 16773-16782): by the More on Morphisms lemma every object U of X_etale admits an etale covering {U_i -> U} to which the computation applies, so the two sheaves agree locally and hence agree on all objects, which is the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an object U -> X with the factorisation U -> V -> S and geometrically connected flat finitely presented structure morphism.
Identify the five terms of the displayed chain using sections upstairs and locality of the pullback.
Use the covering lemma to conclude that the two sheaves agree globally.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the etale pullback along a flat, locally finitely presented morphism with geometrically reduced fibres commutes with products (statement lines 16746-16752). The proof (proof lines 16754-16782) is a five-term computation of sections on a good object, using sections upstairs twice and locality of the pullback, followed by the covering lemma that reduces arbitrary objects to such good ones. H2: one section computation plus locality, written out.
